chunks: Which would cleave the skies asunder, rend the earth, and split the mountains, [into pieces].
ai.seo_question: What cosmic events occur in the heavens and earth according to Surah Mary verse 90?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Mary (48) is often linked to the magnitude of the Divine Name 'Al-Rahman' or the weight of the Quran, emphasizing that creation's structural integrity cannot withstand the revelation of God's ultimate attribute. The imagery of mountains crumbling into dust (haddan) signifies the complete dissolution of worldly permanence, serving as a profound reminder of the Day of Judgment's reality. This cosmic reaction underscores the transformative power of divine truth, which reshapes the very fabric of existence.
